d:
Vaishali Rameshbabu played some incredible chess in the first day of the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot. The event kicked off with the Blitz tiebreaker event, and in an incredibly strong field Vaishali scored 4/9 points - defeating Hans Niemann and Wesley So on the way! In this video, we show you Vaishali's journey throughout the day, and an interview with her after the end of the event.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Himank Ghosh
